tagline: Pattaya's coral-island day-trip — the Eastern Seaboard's highest-frequency hop.
summary: Koh Larn ('Coral Island') sits ~5 nm off Pattaya and is the Eastern Seaboard's highest-frequency island hop, with large daily day-tripper volumes moving off Bali Hai Pier. The short crossing is an ideal Pioneer II leg — proven demand, repeated daily, on a route that today runs crowded diesel speedboats and ferries.

demand_signals.detail: Among the busiest island day-trip legs on the Eastern Seaboard, dispatched off Bali Hai Pier.
~5 nm — ideal for high-frequency, all-electric Pioneer II turns.
Capacity-constrained beaches push steady flow to the island.

use_cases: Bali Hai <-> Koh Larn premium island shuttle

journeys.note: Proven high-frequency hop — already a sealed corridor.

navier_fit: Very high. The short, high-frequency, proven crossing is the model Pioneer II leg; already bound to a gold route_id from the Samui/Gulf seal.
competitive_landscape: Crowded diesel speedboats and ferries on fixed schedules; no premium or in-app tier.
seasonality: Peak: Nov-Mar; sheltered upper-Gulf crossing gives a broad operating window.
regulatory_note: Thai Marine Department licensing; Pattaya/Chonburi pier coordination.

precedents.label: Bali Hai Pier day-trip market
precedents.note: Existing high-frequency volume the foiling tier upgrades.

grab.super_app_fit: In-app coral-island day-trip bundles (boat + GrabCar) from Pattaya/Bangkok.
grab.wedge: The flagship short hop of the Eastern Seaboard — high-frequency, proven, premium-upgradable.
